annotations.title: Etsy listing position for a search

description: Position of a listing (or a shop's listings) in the first 100 active listings Etsy's API returns for a search phrase, in relevance order, and which words of the phrase are missing from its title and tags. Beyond 100 it says 'not in the first 100'. etsy.com search can differ per shopper.
